• Manages warranty, parts, and customer service for Epic Hot Tubs; handles 15–40 inquiries/day.

• A comprehensive SOP document exists in Google Drive and is frequently referenced.

• Immediate goal is "Inbox Zero" for warranty@, starting with inbox organization and template creation.
